answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one karst weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, a hostile operator who spins up 256 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 13 times the capital for one share. The mesa report publishes the merge explicitly at each kernel. A farm of 611 identities would post 1660 proofs and burn roughly 42 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
